title: NFT Lander
tagline: NFT Lander is new way of NFT trading and collecting satble NFT.
description: NFT Lander is a new NFT platform where you can find stable NFT. Stable NFT like stablecoin. The price will be the same when you mint the NFT you decide the price or the auction will happen to get the accurate stable price of the NFT. You can also swap the NFT between the tokens not all NFT but selected NFT.
how_its_made:
NFT Lander is a new NFT platform where you can find stable NFT. It is made using the IPFS and NFT port.

To store the data we have to use IPFS Web3.storage  services using API. NFT port for deploying NFT on-chain easily. We are also planning to swap NFT between tokens by providing liquidity and you can also stake your NFT.
